# GT Marketing

> GT Marketing is a Darwin marketing agency. It builds local SEO, websites and lead-generation systems for small and medium businesses in Darwin, Palmerston, Casuarina and across the Northern Territory.

## Who it is for

Tradies, hospitality businesses, health and NDIS providers, and professional services.

GT Marketing does not position itself around Aboriginal organisations, community-led enterprises, or a regional Australia brief. Older pages that did have been removed. /aboriginal-organisations redirects to the homepage.

## Services

- Local SEO, including Google Business Profile and service-area pages
- Websites that explain the offer and how to enquire
- Lead-generation systems so enquiries can be followed up

Rankings and lead numbers are not guaranteed. Scope and price are agreed before work starts.

## Service area

The only office is 130 Smith Street, Darwin City, Northern Territory 0800. Palmerston, Casuarina, the Top End and Central Australia are service areas, not extra offices.
